output.title: Which plans include a nurse callback?

Question: Which plans include a nurse callback?

Answer: A nurse callback is a service where [description of the service, e.g., a registered nurse calls the member back to discuss symptoms or care questions]. It is included with the following plans: [list of plan names that include nurse callback]. It is not included with: [list of plan names that do not include nurse callback, or 'all other plans'].

How a member requests a callback: [request method, e.g., phone number, member portal, or advocate referral]. Callbacks are available [hours and days of availability] and typically happen within [callback time frame] of the request.

Cost to the member: [cost or confirmation that there is no additional charge].

Eligibility notes: [any eligibility requirements or restrictions, e.g., dependents covered, age limits, or regional availability].

If a member's plan does not include a nurse callback, advocates should [alternative resource or next step, e.g., refer to a nurse line, telehealth benefit, or primary care provider].

How to confirm a member's plan: [where advocates verify plan details, e.g., member record system or benefits summary].
